title: Plot: Add Plot dialog
description:
This MR adds a new dialog to plot display filter fields values over time.

The dialog allows you to select the field to plot, a display filter to limit the selected packets, and a style/color, just like IO/Graph.

It is heavily inspired from IO/Graph, but I don't think it's feasible to integrate the two together, since they have fundamentally different scopes.

One new feature is the ability to plot values on different graphs, by grouping them, instead of having all of them on the same graph.

Please feel free to suggest any improvements or changes.

Fixes #20298.

> It would be nice to be able to plot arbitrary packet matching expressions that can be converted to doubles

I've been using the term "packet matching expressions" to refer to expressions that either involve a Boolean operator, such as comparisons, or that contain a field name with an implicit "is present in the packet" operator.

Perhaps the most general term should be "field expression", as, presumably, a non-constant expression needs to use at least *one* field.

+[#ChStatPlots]
+
+=== The “Plots” Window
+
+Lets you plot display filter field values over time.
+
+.The “Plots” window
+image::images/ws-stats-plots.png[{screenshot-attrs}]
+
+As shown above, this window contains a plot drawing area along with a customizable list of plots.
+Plots are saved in your current <<ChCustConfigProfilesSection,profile>>.
+Each plot shows the value of the specified field (see Y Field below) at each point in time.
+Hovering over the plot shows the packet number of the selected plot at any given time.
+Clicking on the plot takes you to the corresponding packet in the packet list.
+You can drag the plots around with a left click and zoom on a specific area with a right click.
+
+Individual plots can be configured using the following options:
+
+Enabled::
+Draw or don’t draw this plot.
+
+Group #::
+If you don't want all plots on the same graph, you can use this field to
+group them. Each one will be shown in a distinct graph.
+
+Plot Name::
+The name of this plot.
+
+Display Filter::
+Limits the plot to packets that match this filter.
+
+Color::
+The color to use for plotting the plot’s lines or points.
+
+Style::
+How to visually represent the plot’s data, e.g., by drawing a line, circle, plus, etc.
+
+Y Field::
+The display filter field from which to extract values for the Y axis.
+
+Y Axis Factor::
+Scale the Y axis for this plot by multiplying by a constant factor, e.g. to
+present multiple plots at a similar scale.
+
+The plot as a whole can be configured using the controls under the plot list:
+
+btn:[{plus}]::
+Add a new plot.
+
+btn:[-]::
+Remove the selected plot(s).
+
+btn:[Copy]::
+Copy the selected plot(s).
+
+btn:[⌃]:: Move the selected plot(s) up in the list.
+
+btn:[⌄]:: Move the selected plot(s) down in the list.
+
+btn:[Clear]::
+Remove all plots.
+
+Automatic updates::
+Redraw each plot automatically.
+
+Time origin::
+Switch between showing the time relative to first data point and time relative to capture
+start (not available in pcapng).
+
+Log scale::
+Switch between linear and logarithmic Y axis.
+
+Crosshairs::
+Enable/disable the crosshairs cursor.
+
+Top axis::
+Show the axis scale also on top of the plot.
+
+Enable legend::
+Show a plot legend.
+
+The main dialog buttons along the bottom let you do the following:
+
+btn:[Help] will take you to this section of the User’s Guide.
+
+btn:[Reset] will autoscale the axes to fully display all plots.
+
+btn:[Copy] will copy values from selected plot to the clipboard in CSV
+(Comma Separated Values) format.
+
+btn:[Copy from] will let you copy plots from another profile to the current dialog.
+
+btn:[Close] will close this dialog.
+
+btn:[Save As...] will save the currently displayed plot as an image.
+
+[TIP]
+====
+You can see a list of useful keyboard shortcuts by right-clicking on the plot.
+====
